nodes.label: Council Position A: Mechanism-First Demotion
nodes.rationale: Rejects F1-F6/P as exclusive architecture and reduces to four primary mechanisms (exchange, credit, derivative, consensus claim) to establish strict boundary discipline and prevent premature taxonomical sprawl.

nodes.label: Council Position B: Provisional Human Taxonomy and M5 Formal Profile
nodes.norm_label: council position b: provisional human taxonomy and m5 formal profile
nodes.rationale: Separates human market navigation from formal machine behavior by maintaining M2+M3 for people, M5 for verification, and proposing a library-only Compact templates fallback if a new language provides no assurance delta.

nodes.label: Council Position C: Conditional Transfer Base and Certifying Elaboration
nodes.norm_label: council position c: conditional transfer base and certifying elaboration
nodes.rationale: Advocates Moriarty Core as a formal semantic delta against Marlowe, requiring an audit triple and translation-validation certification before observable semantic additions like atomic Step or Attest can be admitted.

nodes.label: Backend Boundedness Hard Stop Condition
nodes.rationale: If generated Compact requires unbounded containers or unconstrained witness callbacks, halt Moriarty Core expansion immediately and default to audited libraries.

nodes.label: Experiment E00 Compact Generation Stop Test
nodes.norm_label: experiment e00 compact generation stop test
nodes.rationale: Verifies that encoding a two-token swap and generating Compact yields no unbounded loops or unconstrained callbacks before expanding Core.

nodes.label: Library-Only Default Fallback
nodes.rationale: Shipping audited Compact templates with obligation manifests is the planned fallback if a bespoke DSL fails to prove lower review cost or superior assurance.

nodes.label: Automatic Project Stop Conditions
nodes.rationale: Specifies eight unconditional termination criteria including conservation failures, unbounded state structures, and failure to beat Compact templates.

nodes.label: Non-Negotiable Language Principles L01-L12
nodes.rationale: Governs language architecture strictly: Moriarty must remain a finite financial agreement DSL with statically checked lifetime envelopes, explicit non-cooperation paths, and value conservation.

nodes.label: Marlowe Capability and Upstream Gap Boundary
nodes.norm_label: marlowe capability and upstream gap boundary
nodes.rationale: Marlowe Core provides verified conservation and termination proofs but lacks token-indexed types, atomic action sets, authorization abstractions, and continuation availability protocols.
